messages:
lina_support: Hey team — Customer BlueSwan (acct: blueswan-42) reporting repeated invoice payment failures this morning. They see `card_declined` + gateway reason `insufficient_funds` on the first attempt, but when they retry from the merchant portal the flow triggers SCA and then the ACS challenge times out. Customer says card is valid. Can payments team help check gateway responses and whether we should offer a forced 3DS reauth or retry?

alex_payments: Got it. Can you paste the charge_id and the raw gateway object from the webhook (if available)? Also which region/processor?

lina_support: charge_id: ch_3Lz92bQK, merchant_tx: inv_8721. Webhook payload excerpt (from their logs):

```
{\n  "status": "declined",\n  "decline_code": "insufficient_funds",\n  "acquirer_code": "51",\n  "authentication_required": true,\n  "acs_url": "https://acs.bank.example/challenge",\n  "acs_timeout_ms": 12000,\n  "note": "ACS challenge started but no final callback received"\n}
```

Also they included our portal logs showing a 3DS redirect then a blank/error page.

sam_engineer: Thanks — I pulled the charge. In our logs I see repeated attempts and an auth window opened but our ACS monitor flagged a timeout:

```
[INFO] 2025-06-01T14:07:02Z start_acs_challenge ch_3Lz92bQK
[WARN] 2025-06-01T14:07:16Z acs_no_callback ch_3Lz92bQK (elapsed 14.2s)
[ERROR] 2025-06-01T14:07:16Z fallback_decline reason=acs_timeout gateway=AtlasBank region=eu-west-1
```

Looks like ACS callback is not making it back to the merchant session before our 15s cutoff, so we abort and mark as declined.

maria_finance: Is this only AtlasBank / EU region or broader? Customer is worried about invoice backlog — any safe manual remediation?

alex_payments: Early signal suggests AtlasBank only — payments-bot also shows elevated 3DS timeouts for that acquirer in eu-west-1. If the card is low on funds, even after auth it may still decline. But the ACS timeout is separate and causes an auth failure.

payments-bot: Alert: acquirer AtlasBank - 3DS ACS timeouts increased to 8.7% (baseline 0.9%) in eu-west-1 between 13:45-14:30Z.

acs-monitor-bot: Observed increased latency to ACS endpoints: average RTT 9800ms, spike to 14.6s. Recommend increasing ACS window to 25s for manual retry flows only.

sam_engineer: Options: 1) Ask merchant to retry payment and stay on the auth page until challenge completes (fragile). 2) Offer customer to update card or use alternative payment method. 3) We can perform a server-side rerun with extended ACS timeout for this specific charge (requires payments team approval and audit log).

lina_support: Customer requested we try a reprocess first. What's the safe API call?

alex_payments: We have a reprocess endpoint in the portal that can attempt a new authorization: POST /internal/charges/reprocess { "charge_id": "ch_3Lz92bQK", "acs_timeout_ms": 25000 } — must be run by payments team and will create a new auth attempt. Note: this may still fail if actual funds are insufficient. Please get merchant consent and document as "manual reauth" in the invoice notes.

maria_finance: Go ahead and reprocess if payments team OKs. We'll mark invoice as "awaiting-retry" for 24h so accounting doesn't auto-escalate.

alex_payments: I'll run it now. Quick checklist: merchant confirmation in thread, svc-account name used for action, and we log before/after webhook IDs. Lina, can you confirm merchant consent in this thread? :eyes:

lina_support: Confirmed — merchant asked us to try reprocessing once. They will wait on the challenge page.

alex_payments: Executing reprocess. Command (internal only):

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.example/internal/charges/reprocess \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_PAYMENTS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"charge_id":"ch_3Lz92bQK","acs_timeout_ms":25000}'
```

alex_payments: Reprocess started. New auth id: auth_rN8Q. I'll post results when ACS callback completes.

sam_engineer: FYI, I'll add a short-term metric alert to watch AtlasBank ACS timeouts and roll back the increased timeout if we see a big spike in stuck sessions.

payments-bot: Reprocess result: auth_rN8Q -> status: authentication_required, ACS challenge completed, final gateway outcome: declined (insufficient_funds). Acquirer code: 51.

lina_support: Merchant confirmed they saw the challenge and the bank declined due to insufficient funds. They've arranged alternative payment and asked for guidance on retry limits.

maria_finance: We'll advise merchants to attempt up to 2 manual reauths spaced 10-30 minutes apart and to update card on file if both fail. Finance will hold invoice escalation for 48 hours given merchant cooperation.

alex_payments: Closing the support action — root cause: combination of ACS timeouts (caused by AtlasBank latency spike) and card-level insufficient funds. Action items: (1) payments team to monitor AtlasBank and open ticket with acquirer, (2) engineering to add per-acquirer ACS latency dashboards, (3) update merchant help doc with recommended retry guidance.

lina_support: Thanks all — will pass outcome to BlueSwan. :white_check_mark:
